classification.difficultyReason: Read values from two differently oriented graphs (column and bar) with different scales, then subtract and compare across graphs. No misleading-graph trap and nothing to match, so it is easier than matching tables to four charts.

content.prompt: The graphs show the favourite sport of the students in Year 7 and in Year 8.

children.label: a
children.prompt: How many more Year 8 students than Year 7 students chose swimming?

children.label: b
children.prompt: Which sport was chosen by the same number of students in both years?

answer.worked:
Year 7: netball 12, soccer 15, swimming 8, tennis 6.
Year 8: netball 12, soccer 22, swimming 18, tennis 14.
Only netball has the same value, 12, in both years.
